newsitem.title: USA: Genzyme Tissue up ahead of FDA meeting.
newsitem.headline: Genzyme Tissue up ahead of FDA meeting.

text.p: Shares in Genzyme Corp's Tissue Repair Division jumped on Tuesday, ahead of a Food and Drug Administration review of the company's cartilage repair technology.
Genzyme Tissue was up 2-1/8, or 19 percent, to 13-5/8 in early afternoon. Volume was a heavy 404,500 shares.
Shares in parent Genzyme Corp rose 1-1/4 to 26-1/2 in light volume.
Genzyme Tissue's license application for its Carticel service is on the agenda of the Food and Drug Administration's Orthopedic and Rehabilitation Devices Panel meeting scheduled for Thursday.
The Carticel technology grows a patient's own cartilage cells to repair knee damage.

"There is a growing degree of confidence in the investor community that their cartilage replacement technology is going to catch hold, is going to work," said Eddie Hedaya of BioVest Research Inc in Hartsdale, N.Y.
